info.title: Polymatik Product API
info.description: Product API with reviewed catalog, private account Library and optional private subject interests. Managed sessions are revalidated. PostgreSQL uses Hyperdrive and row-level security. Interests do not change ranking or represent mastery. Versioned /v2/resources supports bounded catalog discovery; legacy v1 and account contracts remain unchanged. Expanded /v2/library and /v2/interests preserve legacy v1 account wire shapes.

get.description: Only limit, cursor, subject, kind, q are accepted, once each. Decoded responses are capped at 64 KiB. Requires catalog schema 0003; unconfigured fixture mode returns 503. Queries do not personalize ranking or update preferences.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Canonical decimal 1..5. Fetches at most limit+1 rows for continuation.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Unmodified next_cursor from the same filters. Unsigned and non-secret; altered positions never change publication checks.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Matches primary OR secondary subject.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Exact resource format.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed nonempty literal case-insensitive substring of title/source/publisher/description. Percent and underscore are literal. No full-text ingestion or semantic ranking.

200.description: Up to five public resources; unique stable sort_order/id keyset order. No totals or private editorial metadata. Mutations to publication/order between pages may change results; restart to refresh.

422.description: Malformed ID, unknown/duplicate query key, invalid bounds or cursor/filter mismatch.

503.description: Catalog storage/schema unavailable or invalid. No bundled fallback.

managedSession.name: __Secure-neon-auth.session_token
managedSession.description: Opaque Neon managed session token; independently revalidated against the configured branch. Local development may use the unprefixed neon-auth.session_token.

url.description: Fixed reviewed original HTTPS URL from the preview catalog.

key.description: Must match the enclosing canonical ID and version. Delivery is enabled separately after asset review.

CatalogCover.description: Approved selected cover metadata with exact 3:2 dimensions; no master path or reviewer fields.

url.description: Canonical ASCII HTTPS source URL, with no credentials; publication review is separate from transport validation.

secondary_subjects.description: Canonical subject order; excludes the primary topic.

CatalogEntry.description: Expanded reviewed public metadata. Editorial scores, rights evidence, reviewers and source-run internals are excluded. Cover is a reviewed storage reference, never an arbitrary remote URL. Only the four historical resources may have null covers.

next_cursor.description: Opaque versioned continuation, bound to subject/kind/q; null at end. Not an authorization token or snapshot guarantee.

AccountLibraryItem.description: Only the verified account owns this save. Null metadata retains an unavailable saved identity without exposing unpublished content.

AccountLibraryPage.description: Newest saves first, canonical ID breaks timestamp ties. Five-item keyset pages; continuations never confer identity or snapshot guarantees.

AccountLibraryChange.description: Idempotent mutation acknowledgement; refresh paginated reads separately. PUT resolves public aliases to canonical IDs.
